decisions.reason: The glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm's core industrial door range and costs little to keep on the market, so the option is still worth more than its carrying cost while there is no evidence that its value has failed to materialize.
The insulated glazed variant meets energy-efficiency demand in commercial buildings and shares production with the core door lines, so its low carrying cost justifies holding the option.

Its own dedicated web page in both observed years signals continued commitment, and since it is integrated into the established industrial door business, keeping it costs little relative to its remaining upside.
